units.name: Management Department
units.evidence: Current catalog explicitly names the Management Department and school. Its curriculum combines Operations Management, Quality Management & Improvement, and Supply Chain Management; supply chain is required in the supervisory and small-business options. These are courses within the verified department, not separate departments.

decisions.reason: Operations Management shorthand replaced by its verified Management Department host; no separate Operations department invented.
